profile.summary: Quetzal Education Consulting is an Oakland-based education consulting firm. It works with schools, school districts, universities and nonprofits on anti-oppression consultation, anti-racist math and STEM education, systemic change, workshops and professional development. It says it supports institutions building liberatory education with Black and Brown communities.
